posts.author: Joe Farina
posts.content_md:
In addition to what Colin said, you may want to contact Don Gillespie at El Don Engineering in Ann Arbor, Michigan. He may have one, or know someone who does.

I've also been having problems with my SP-124 and SP-107. There was a high-voltage arc in the head of the 124, and Don thought it may have damaged the power supply, so I sent the whole thing to him. On the 107, one of the pins on the Alden connector had poor contact with the socket, causing arcing there, and the power supply quit working entirely.
